Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 12 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Kavita - 42 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Vikram - 38 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Kavita and Vikram stand near him.]

Aarav: "What lovely weather!"

[Aarav feeds the dog.]

Aarav: "That's great!"

[Aarav milks the cow.]

Vikram: "And then?"

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Vikram: "That was fun!"

[Aarav pats his horse.]

Aarav (excited): "Dad, listen!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Aarav stands in the living room. Kavita stands near him.]

Kavita: "What a nice place."

[Aarav takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Kavita (surprised): "I'm ready!"

[Aarav drinks a glass of water.]

Aarav: "One more time!"

[Aarav sips hot tea from a cup.]

Aarav: "What a day to remember!"
